description: Advisory code-coverage report: runs the UI Vitest suite under v8 coverage and reports line/branch/function/statement percentages. Deliberately a REPORT, not a gate — no threshold fails it, and it is wired into facet.functionality as advisory so it can never turn the facet red. The point is a visible number to inform where to test next, not a bar to game. See specs/decisions/0002-code-quality-metrics.md.
